about: Volume-spike radar replay. Paper only. Not financial advice.

config.about: 15-minute volume-spike radar (Watch, Priority, Notification, Retest, Fade). Every number below can be changed; push the file and the GitHub job reruns the replay on the cached candles. Paper only, not financial advice.

sessions.calendarSources: TSE: jpx.co.jp market holidays page (checked). NYSE: nyse.com hours-calendars (checked). LSE: londonstockexchange.com half days 24 and 31 Dec and 25/28 Dec closures, 31 Aug bank holiday (checked); 1 Jan, 3 Apr, 6 Apr, 4 May, 25 May from public calendars (not checked against the exchange page).

data.about: Which Binance 15m history the replay downloads. Change this file only to change the data window or the coin list; the GitHub job keeps a cache keyed on this file, so rule changes in spike-radar2.config.json rerun in about a minute without downloading again. Raise cacheVersion to force a fresh download.

outcomes.O2: next candle high > +5% from alert close
outcomes.O3: any of next 4 closes > +5% from alert close
outcomes.N1: as O1 but from the next open
outcomes.N2: as O2 but from the next open
outcomes.N3: as O3 but from the next open
